## 🧭 Readiness areas
| Area | Acceptance evidence | Status | Owner / follow-up |

| Functional behavior | Critical user journeys executed. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Build and deployment | Reproducible build and deployment record. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Security | Threat review and security checks. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Privacy | Data flow, retention, disclosure reviewed. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Accessibility | Manual and automated review evidence. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Performance | Measured baseline against agreed budget. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Reliability | Failure and recovery behavior assessed. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Monitoring | Logs/alerts and incident ownership defined. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Backup/recovery | Backup and restore validated where needed. | [Status] | [Action] |
| Documentation | Setup, operation, known limitations current. | [Status] | [Action] |
